metaTitle: Brazil INSS and IRRF Calculator 2026 | Calculaderia
metaDescription: Estimate monthly Brazilian INSS and IRRF on salary with 2026 tables, dependents, alimony, simplified discount, and calculation memory.

helpers.base: Enter the monthly taxable remuneration that composes the Brazilian contribution and withholding base. The calculator does not classify payroll rubrics.
helpers.otherPay: Use this to add taxable amounts from the same competence month.
helpers.category: This version uses the same 2026 INSS table for employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker.
helpers.dependents: The dependent deduction used in the 2026 monthly table is R$189.59.
helpers.alimony: Enter only deductible alimony from an applicable court order or agreement.
helpers.simplified: When enabled, the standard base is compared with the R$607.20 monthly simplified discount and the lower permitted base is used.
helpers.tableBadge: INSS/IRRF 2026 tables, source sv=2026-07-07, accessed on 2026-07-07.
helpers.scope: Employee-side legal deduction estimate; it does not calculate a full payslip, FGTS, benefits, payment forms, or official payroll closing.

howToCalculate.title: How to calculate INSS and IRRF in Brazil in 2026
howToCalculate.p1: The calculation starts from the entered monthly taxable remuneration. Employee INSS is progressive by bands and capped at the 2026 social-security ceiling.
howToCalculate.p2: After INSS, the calculator builds the monthly IRRF base with dependents, deductible alimony, and comparison with the monthly simplified discount when enabled.

order.title: Does INSS come before IRRF?
order.text: Yes. In this monthly estimate, INSS calculated on the contribution base reduces the standard IRRF base, together with dependents and deductible alimony.

tables.title: 2026 INSS table and 2026 monthly IRRF table
tables.inss: The 2026 INSS table used here covers employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker categories, with 7.5%, 9%, 12%, and 14% bands.
tables.irrf: The 2026 monthly IRRF table uses Receita brackets, R$189.59 dependent deduction, R$607.20 simplified discount, and the monthly reduction.

deductions.title: Dependents, alimony, and simplified discount
deductions.text: Dependents and deductible alimony reduce the standard base. The monthly simplified discount is compared separately and only changes the result if it creates a lower base.

officialDifference.title: Why the official payslip can differ
officialDifference.text: Official payroll may include specific rubrics, multiple employment links, rounding, eSocial setup, agreements, absences, benefits, and court orders.

salaryNet.title: When to use net salary instead of this calculator
salaryNet.text: Use this page to check only INSS and IRRF. For benefits, advances, manual deductions, non-taxable additions, and net salary, use the net salary calculator.

officialLinks.title: Official sources
officialLinks.intro: This version's constants were checked against official sources accessed on 2026-07-07.

related.title: Related calculators
related.intro: Use other Brazilian labor and tax calculators when the scenario is broader than monthly INSS and IRRF.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational payroll and tax estimate, not legal, tax, accounting, or official payroll advice. Payslip, eSocial, paying source, agreements, court orders, Receita, INSS, and professional review prevail.

q1.question: Which INSS and IRRF tables are used?
q1.answer: The calculator uses 2026 tables checked against official sources on 2026-07-07, with URLs marked by tb=2026 and sv=2026-07-07.

q2.question: Does INSS enter the IRRF base?
q2.answer: Calculated INSS reduces the standard monthly IRRF base. The calculator also compares the simplified base when that option is enabled.

q3.question: How much do dependents reduce IRRF?
q3.answer: In this version, each dependent reduces R$189.59 from the standard 2026 monthly IRRF base.

q4.question: Is the monthly simplified discount automatic?
q4.answer: By default, yes. The calculator compares the standard base with the R$607.20 simplified base and uses the lower one. You can turn the comparison off.

q5.question: Why can my official payslip be different?
q5.answer: The official payslip may consider rubrics, multiple links, rounding, agreements, absences, benefits, court orders, and settings this estimate cannot access.

q6.question: Does this work for MEI, autonomous workers, or pro-labore?
q6.answer: No. This version covers employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker categories under the employee contribution table.

q7.question: Does this calculator show net salary?
q7.answer: No. It shows only INSS, IRRF, and the remainder before other payroll items. Use the dedicated net salary calculator for a fuller estimate.

q8.question: What changes with multiple employment links or paying sources?
q8.answer: The INSS ceiling and IRRF withholding can depend on allocation across links and paying sources. This page estimates from the entered total and does not split amounts by employer.
